# Patterns

<!-- Generated by generate-indexes.mjs; edit contracts, then regenerate. -->

- **Filter records**
  - Description: Narrow the visible records with a name search, a value search, on/off chips, and an advanced dialog that starts closed.
  - Contract: [contract](patterns/filter-records.md)

- **Inspect a record**
  - Description: Open one selected record beside the view, or in a bottom drawer when the shell is narrow, and close it without losing the row.
  - Contract: [contract](patterns/inspect-record.md)

- **Undoable destructive action**
  - Description: Run a destructive action with a danger button, then offer one undo for a limited time. The toast does not restore the data itself.
  - Contract: [contract](patterns/undoable-destructive-action.md)
